input.query:
MATCH (impl:Type)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->(iface:Type)
WHERE iface.fqn IN [
  'org.thingsboard.server.dao.edge.EdgeService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.service.entitiy.edge.TbEdgeService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.service.security.permission.AccessControlService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.service.edge.instructions.EdgeUpgradeInstructionsService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.dao.rule.RuleChainService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.service.edge.rpc.EdgeRpcService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.service.edge.instructions.EdgeInstallInstructionsService'
]
MATCH (a:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(impl)
RETURN iface.fqn AS interface_fqn,
       impl.fqn AS impl_fqn,
       split(a.fileName, '/target/')[0] + '/src/main/java/' + replace(impl.fqn, '.', '/') + '.java' AS impl_file
ORDER BY interface_fqn, impl_fqn
